ControlLogix PLC System Building Blocks

A ControlLogix PLC is the rack based, fully modular controller at the top of the Allen Bradley range, built for large, distributed and high availability systems. Unlike a brick type MicroLogix, every function sits in its own module in a chassis, so a system can be expanded or repaired module by module. The table lists the main parts an engineer selects when building one.

Building blockRole in the system
Chassis (rack)Backplane that holds and connects all modules
Power supplySeparate module that feeds the chassis backplane
ControllerHigh performance processor that runs the tag based logic, motion and process tasks
I/O modulesDigital and analog cards for field signals, local or in remote distributed racks
Communication modulesEtherNet/IP and other network links to HMIs, drives and remote I/O
Redundancy optionA second controller chassis that takes over if the primary fails

Programming is done in Studio 5000 Logix Designer, the same software used for CompactLogix, so tags, routines and diagnostics look the same across both families. This is why many plants use CompactLogix on machines and a ControlLogix PLC for the main process, keeping one skill set for training and troubleshooting. Choose ControlLogix when the I/O count is large, the network is distributed, or downtime carries a high financial or safety risk.
